title: Ibhokisi yeSanti kaLesedi
description: Iphupha likaLesedi lokuya elwandle. Ufuna ukuva isanti phakathi kweenzwane zakhe aze akhe ibhotwe lesanti. Ngoko ke abazali bakhe beza necebo.
